notes:
Added:
- Landscape / Portrait switch in the Encoding Settings of Render H264/H265, Concat, Intro/Outro/Logo and Chroma Key: pick Portrait and the resolution presets become vertical (1080p → 1080x1920). Typing a vertical size switches it to Portrait by itself.
- "Different aspect ratio" option: Auto (Portrait crops to fill the frame, Landscape keeps the whole picture on a black background), Crop to fill, or Keep the whole picture with black bars.
- Concat now has the Audio Sample Rate field like the other render tools.

Changed:
- A video in a different aspect ratio than the output is never stretched any more: it is centre-cropped or centred on black, in every render tool and in the livestream transcode (non-Original) mode.
- Switching Landscape/Portrait or a preset moves the logo and the green-screen layer with the frame (a corner logo stays in its corner, a full-frame layer stays full-frame), and a layer is never placed outside the picture.
- Intro/Outro/Logo and Chroma Key render faster (no hidden background layer is composited under every frame any more).
- Encoding Settings look the same in all four tools; the "enable NVIDIA GPU in Settings" tip now sits in that card.
- The NVIDIA GPU setting is read once per batch, so every file of a batch uses the same encoder.

Fixed:
- Vertical (9:16) videos rendered to a vertical size with Intro/Outro/Logo came out squashed — players showed them as 16:9.
- Intros, outros or videos without sound can now be joined: they get silence of their own length instead of failing. A silent Chroma Key base video renders too.
- Concat of clips with and without sound keeps the audio in sync (silent clips get a silent track when others have sound).
- A malformed video size (e.g. 1080*1920) now shows "Invalid video size" with the reason on each row instead of an unclear ffmpeg error.
- Basic Live Stream scripts use the new sizing too; saved scripts are upgraded automatically on launch.
